Ananya Rao
Pune, India | ananya.rao@example.com | github.com/example-ananya
(Synthetic demo profile - not a real person)
SUMMARY
Computer science student focused on backend engineering with Java and Spring Boot. Enjoys designing clean REST
EDUCATION
B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Example Institute of Technology, Pune 2022 - 2026
CGPA 8.6/10. Coursework: Data Structures, Algorithms, Database Management Systems, Operating Systems.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Java, Python, SQL, JavaScript
Frameworks: Spring Boot, Hibernate, React, Flask
Databases: MySQL, MongoDB
Tools: Git, GitHub, Maven, Postman, Linux, IntelliJ IDEA
EXPERIENCE
Software Engineering Intern | Example Fintech Pvt. Ltd. Jun 2025 - Aug 2025
- Built REST APIs in Java with Spring Boot for an internal loan-tracking dashboard used by 40 analysts.
- Wrote JUnit tests for the service layer and fixed 12 production bugs reported by QA.
- Optimised slow MySQL queries by adding indexes, reducing report generation time from 9s to 2s.
- Collaborated with a cross-functional team in two-week Agile sprints and took part in code reviews.
PROJECTS
Campus Library Management System | Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Hibernate
- Designed a RESTful backend with JWT authentication and role-based access for students and librarians.
- Modelled 8 relational tables with Hibernate and wrote integration tests for the borrowing workflow.
- Containerized the application with Docker and documented the API with Swagger.
Expense Splitter Web App | React, Flask, MongoDB
- Built a React front end and a Flask API that splits shared expenses between group members.
- Stored groups and transactions in MongoDB and deployed the app on Render.
Sentiment Analyzer for Product Reviews | Python, scikit-learn
- Trained a logistic regression classifier on 20,000 public product reviews with 87% validation accuracy.
- Built text preprocessing with NLTK and visualised results with Matplotlib.
CERTIFICATIONS
Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer
Postman API Fundamentals Student Expert
ACHIEVEMENTS
Finalist, Example University Hackathon 2024 (team of 4).
